prompts.tokens: Use case: stylized-concept. prompts.surfaces: Use case: texture. Production background TEXTURE ATLAS for elegant digital board/card games. ONE SQUARE image divided into EXACT THREE equal-width vertical panels, edge-to-edge, no gutters. Left third: warm medium walnut wood, fine natural quiet grain, top-down flat, softly illuminated neutral light; middle third: deep pine-green casino felt, tactile fine wool microtexture, subtle mottling, softly lit flat; right third: muted dusky-plum woven cotton upholstery, delicate diagonal fabric weave, softly lit flat. No subjects, no board markings, no cards, no objects, no shadows cast by objects, no frames, no seams between horizontal tiles, no text, no vignette. Each third is a consistent seamless-looking material swatch, sophisticated warm editorial game-night atmosphere, low contrast texture so overlaid cards and controls are legible. Absolute top-down orthographic surface, no perspective. Exactly3 vertical equal panels. No people or logos.
